resources.string: A counter in the corner: frames per second and milliseconds per frame.

A disc image (the Xbox 360 ISO) is read in place, taking no extra space. Or an extracted folder (default.xex, the two .xex DLLs and media), copied to Internal storage/%1$s (7.3 GB). With the ISO, the native renderer\'s fh2_shaders.nfsp goes next to it or in %1$s.
A frame that misses the vsync by a little is shown at once, instead of waiting for the next one. It does not change the fps; turn it off if you notice judder.
Above Normal the sound may distort at its peaks.
Asks for root (Magisk, KernelSU) and adds the game\'s full crash files, the kernel log and the whole logcat to the zip. Read only: nothing is changed.
Choose the game\'s extracted folder (with default.xex, the two .xex DLLs and media). It will be copied to Internal storage/%1$s (7.3 GB).
Choose what vibrates when the game requests rumble.
Copying the game to Internal storage/
Could not find that ISO\'s path. Pick the file through the internal storage or the memory card (in the picker, menu ☰ → the device name), not through \"Recent\".
Could not load the diagnostics library
Could not open the target file.

Creates the small render targets (reflection cube) at their exact height instead of 720 rows: smaller passes and less tile traffic. If the game ever resolves below the image, it grows back to full height on its own.
Emulated: the Xbox 360 GPU, emulated. The tested mode, and the most faithful to the console\'s image.
Every language on the disc: texts, menus and the sat nav voice. The ones marked voiced also have the dialogue in that language. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

Experimental. The copy of the finished scene (before the HUD) is only made if something will use it, like the raindrops; if the game does not, the GPU saves the copy. It turns itself off if it sees a difference. Gain not measured yet.
Experimental. When the game copies an image it drew to use it as a texture, the copy stays on the GPU, without going through the emulated console\'s memory. Turn it off if an image looks wrong.

Export copies your progress (profile and saves). Import replaces the current progress with an export or one of the automatic backups (jogos/%1$s-saves). To take the save to another phone, copy the exported folder to the same place on it and import.
Extra sharpness on top of CAS or FSR: 0 keeps the default. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Faces of the car\'s reflection map redrawn every frame.
fh2_shaders.nfsp, next to the game files (%1$s). Without it the native renderer has no translated shaders.
FIFO waits for the screen\'s vsync: the fastest (+57 % in the menu), and it runs cooler. MAILBOX repaints nonstop: a little less lag, but it takes CPU and GPU from the game.
Forza Horizon 2 for the Xbox 360, recompiled for Android.
From an export or an automatic backup
FXAA smooths jagged edges with a cheap filter over the final image.
Hide the controls when a gamepad is used
High smooths more edges, the faint ones too, and softens the image a little.
How far objects cast shadows: nearly all of their cost is there. Far is the game\'s own.
How much of the Xbox 360\'s resolution (1280×720) the game draws, in 12.5 % steps. Below 100 % the image is less sharp and the GPU works much less.
How much of the Xbox 360\'s resolution (1280×720) the game draws: the scene and the post-processing (the HUD gets less sharp too). Below 100 % the GPU works much less.
How often the shadow maps are redrawn. Every 2 frames costs less and is hardly noticed.
How the image is brought to the screen\'s size. FSR is sharper when the game draws below the screen\'s resolution; CAS only sharpens.
Image stretched to the whole screen

Import an Android driver\'s .zip (Turnip, Mesa\'s free driver for Adreno, or a Qualcomm one, with meta.json). Before a driver is chosen the app tests whether it opens Vulkan on this GPU. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

Instead of the ring, gives the fastest core to the game\'s busiest thread (it changes on loads, and the mode follows it). For heavy scenery, where the game thread saturates before the ring; off keeps the mode above.
Keeps the game on the processor\'s fast cores only, and the GPU command processor (the emulated or the native one) alone on the fastest (+16 %).
Locks the GPU clock instead of letting the system adjust it. Only with Turnip on an Adreno GPU. It does not always help: check with the FPS counter.
Logs and device information in a .zip, to look into a problem. Nothing is sent.
Makes the phone vibrate when the gamepad vibrates. Intensity follows the game.
Measure the GPU in the logs
MSAA 2x/4x draws the 3D scene with 2/4 samples and resolves in the pass (costs GPU); FXAA is a cheap filter over the final image.
Native (experimental): draws the game\'s commands straight in Vulkan, with the translated shaders. Much faster, but it still has image errors.

Next game only: after 60 s of play, records 10 s with simpleperf and saves where the game spends the CPU (per thread and per function) in the session log, which goes into the report. Needs root: the permission prompt shows when you turn it on, not during the game. Measures only.
No root: the phone is not rooted or the permission was denied. The performance profile will not be recorded.
No root: the phone is not rooted or the permission was denied. The usual diagnostics are still available.
No save to import in jogos/
Off: the game waits for each new shader to be ready, which can stutter. On: it goes on without waiting, with less stutter, but that shader\'s object may vanish or flicker for a moment.
Off: the Xbox 360\'s 16:9 image, with black bars. On: fills the screen, but distorts the image.

On: a thread of its own decodes the game\'s sound and spares the CPU, but on some phones the sound stutters or sounds robotic. Off: the game decodes its own sound, as before. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Opening the driver and creating a Vulkan device…
Opens the driver the way the game does, creates a Vulkan device and checks what the renderers need. It runs in a separate process: a driver that crashes does not take the app with it.
Pick the renderer: the options below are its own.
Put every control back in its original place and size?
Read straight from the file: no extracting or copying
Reuses the already converted indices the game has not changed since the previous frame, instead of converting and copying them again.

Reuses the vertices the game has not changed since the previous frame instead of copying them again: 87 % less data sent to the GPU. On the S23 Ultra, standing still, +35 % fps (27 → 36.5); in a landscape with a lot of vegetation, from ~30 to ~40 fps.
Sharper textures seen at an angle, like the road in the distance.
Shortcut: render scale + FSR 1.0 together (77/67/59/50/33 % of 1280x720). Off keeps the scale and effect chosen above.
Show GPU, CPU and RAM use
Size of the final image on the screen (the native one is %1$s×%2$s). The game renders the same way.
Size of the sun\'s shadow maps (the game uses four of 1024×1024). Smaller makes shadow edges blurrier and eases the GPU; 0 turns shadows off. Applied when the game starts.
Smooths jagged edges. MSAA is the game\'s own and the costliest for the GPU (off gives +91 %; 2x costs less than 4x, +37 %); FXAA is a cheap filter over the final image.
Tap a control to pick it · drag to move it · pinch to resize it
Tells Android how long each frame worked and the FPS limit\'s target, so it raises the processor\'s clock when a frame does not fit the target.
The driver crashed the test process while opening.
The driver is no longer installed
The driver leaves the phone and the game goes back to the system driver.
the driver must be an Android ARM64 library (.so), not a PC or 32-bit one
the driver .so is empty or unreadable
The driver test took over 20 seconds
the file is not an Xbox 360 disc image
The final image and what shows over it.
The folder must have default.xex, XMediaFacade_default.xex, SpeechFacade_default.xex and media.
The game can use this driver.
The game draws the scene in 3 tiles because of MSAA; without it the scene fits whole and is drawn once: less work for the CPU (+25 %). Only with anti-aliasing off or FXAA.
The game files and your progress.
The game folder has an invalid name.
The game folder has an invalid path.
The game may not start with it. Use it anyway?
The game may not start with this driver.

The game\'s cap; 30 is the Xbox 360\'s. Above it the game shows more frames if the phone keeps up, and the screen switches to its highest rate. Start screens and loadings may reach twice the cap. More frames mean more heat.
The game\'s language and this app\'s.
The GPU starts a pass\'s geometry while it still shades the previous one, instead of waiting for every pass to finish. The image is the same.
The imported driver did not load (one of its libraries is missing, or it is not for this GPU) and the system used the stock driver instead.
The list comes from the game itself: open the game once and it shows up here.
The processor and the GPU driver.
The report is no longer there. Make another.
The save from %1$s replaces the current one. The current one stays in the automatic backup of the last time the game started.
There is no app to save files.
They are stored, but the game does not apply them yet.

This app was recompiled from the %1$s edition and your default.xex is from another one (SHA-256 %2$s…). The game does not run with another edition.\n\nUse a copy of the %1$s edition (the SHA-256 of its default.xex starts with %3$s).
this driver needs Android API %1$s or newer (this is %2$s)
This menu and the touch controls panel.
⚠ This phone\'s GPU lacks a feature the emulated renderer needs (vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics): with it the game does not start. Use the native renderer.
To use Internal storage/%1$s, allow the file access Android asks for.
Turned off, it breaks the game: only the bottom band of the screen shows, with black and grey bands above.
Turnip and Qualcomm drivers are for Adreno GPUs only: with this GPU, use the system driver.
Under the FPS: GPU load; the game\'s CPU (of all cores) and the busiest thread (near 100 % it is what limits the FPS); the game\'s memory and the phone\'s free memory, in GB.
What happened? How to reproduce it? (optional)
Without MSAA the scene fits whole and is drawn once, not in 3 tiles: less work for the CPU (+25 %).

Writes every repetition of the messages that repeat many times a second (renderer textures, unimplemented functions). Off, each shows only its first 20 times, and the log keeps more play time. For investigating only.
Writes to the log how long the GPU spends on each part of the frame. For investigating only: it slows the game down, since each measurement makes the GPU wait.
